manifest.searchPolicy: Complete configured statistical-ranging candidate count; external worker timeout rejects incomplete jobs

methodology: Separate process per configuration;2warmups+4samples per case; GC housekeeping outside timed command, recorded separately. Every instance/heap/filesystem stays fresh.
